verdict.rationale: Jev offers an interactive Playground where you paste state and run Noul/Choice/Score questions live, plus generated SDK API reference pages and copy-paste cURL/Python/JavaScript examples (e.g., GET /v1/models). However, the reference docs appear to be static markdown, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so there is no evidence of an interactive try-it API explorer. missing for 10: interactive API reference with in-page runnable requests (try-it console), published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
